messages.content: What did Dorothy poke the sleeping boy at the station with?
Her parasol.
What did he do as he woke up?
He sat up and rubbed his eyes.
What did the Tin Woodman smash the vase with to free the prisoner?
His axe.
Which animal had he freed?
Ozma's lost piglet.
What did Jim see flying toward them when the talking stopped?
The Gargoyles.
How did he make them scatter in that first attack?
He kicked them.
What did the Mangaboo Prince place on the Princess's forehead at her command?
The Star of Royalty.
What did it stand for?
The authority of the Mangaboo ruler.
What mark did the Wizard paint on his balloon and circus gear?
His initials, O. Z.
What was the mark meant to show?
The balloon and gear belonged to the Wizard.
What happened to the Wizard's sword on the first blow against the wooden people?
Its blade snapped into a dozen pieces.
